messages.subject: For Stuart Fitzgerald | Government relations, stakeholder strategy and offshore energy
messages.body:
Dear Subsea7 Corporate Communications Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Stuart Fitzgerald, Chief Executive Officer, where appropriate.

Subsea7 operates across offshore energy markets where project execution, government relationships, local value and stakeholder confidence directly affect long-term performance. That environment closely matches my current executive responsibilities.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory across complex resource, infrastructure and logistics matters.

I would welcome a senior conversation regarding roles where this combination of government relations, emerging-market stakeholder leadership and cross-functional execution could support Subsea7's international priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Subsea7.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
